name: Vajra Ring
principle: Snares all things · independent of the wielder's mana · with an embedded 'binding rule'
evidence: The One-Horned Rhinoceros's own mana is not top-tier, yet it can snare Wukong's Golden-Banded Staff, the gods' weapons, Nezha's weapons, even water and fire

name: Purple-Gold Red Gourd
owner: Golden Horn King · Silver Horn King (originally Taishang Laojun's)
category: Causal-Law Weapon · answering one's name brings death
principle: Call the name and it answers; whoever answers enters the gourd and dissolves into pus and blood
evidence: Wukong was once trapped by the false name 'Zhe Xingsun' · dissolved into pus and blood · escaped by means of a false name

name: Human Seed Pouch
principle: Open the pouch · people enter · none of the gods can escape
evidence: Took the Twenty-Eight Mansions · the Five-Direction Guardians · Wukong too was nearly captured · saved only by Maitreya's descent

name: Yin-Yang Two-Qi Vase
principle: Enter the vase · within a short span one is reduced to pulp
evidence: Wukong entered the vase · relied on Guanyin's three life-saving hairs · bored through and destroyed it

name: Palm-Leaf Fan
power_source: A heaven-and-earth spirit-treasure · the innate primal qi
principle: One fan-stroke sends wind 84,000 li · quenches the Flaming Mountains
evidence: The Rakshasi's own mana is middling, yet the fan made her a local hegemon

name: Golden-Banded Staff
power_source: The Sea-Pacifying Needle left by Yu the Great for flood control · an innate spirit-treasure
principle: 13,500 jin · shrinks or grows at will
evidence: Driven by Wukong's mana · its upper power limit is set by the wielder

name: Nine-Toothed Rake
power_source: Forged by Taishang Laojun · bestowed by the Jade Emperor
principle: Nine teeth · divine radiance · can build mountains
evidence: Limited by Bajie's mana · the rake's power is never fully realized

name: Tight-Fillet Spell
principle: Recite the spell and it tightens · splitting headache · a control actuator
evidence: Tang Sanzang, a mere mortal, can recite it · independent of the wielder's mana · acts directly on Wukong
